tagline.en: Three-powered UK MVNO — £6 PAYG eSIM, keep alive with one event per 6 months
tagline.zh: 走Three网络的英国虚商——6英镑Paygo eSIM，每半年一次使用即保号

description.en: iD Mobile is a London-based MVNO (founded 2014) running on Three's network, known for flexible, value plans. Its £6 pay-as-you-go eSIM bundles unlimited calls and texts with 1GB of data; any top-up or charged usage every 6 months keeps the number alive.
description.zh: iD Mobile是2014年成立于伦敦的英国虚商，走Three网络，以灵活高性价比著称。其6英镑Paygo eSIM含无限通话短信与1GB流量；每6个月内有一次充值或计费使用即可保号。

details.en: iD Mobile is the low-cost way onto Three's UK network (the network now merged with Vodafone UK, though integration is ongoing): £6 pay-as-you-go buys unlimited UK calls and texts plus 1GB — usable as a keep-alive base with light real usage. Keep-alive bar: at least one top-up or charged usage per 6 months, the most relaxed cadence among reviewed UK options (giffgaff/VOXI/Lycamobile use 180-day windows). Monthly plans and PAYG both exist; eSIM is selectable at checkout. Trade-offs common to budget MVNOs apply: traffic priority sits below Three's own subscribers, and the source review groups iD with the budget-MVNO tier — fine for a cheap UK number, not the first pick for mainland-China roaming reliability.
details.zh: iD Mobile是上Three英国网络的低价途径（该网络已与Vodafone英国合并，整合进行中）：6英镑Paygo含英国无限通话短信+1GB流量，可当保号底座轻度使用。保号门槛：每6个月至少一次充值或计费使用，是本轮盘点英国选项中最宽松的节奏（giffgaff/VOXI/Lycamobile均为180天窗口）。月付与Paygo并存，下单可选eSIM。低价虚商的共性取舍：流量优先级低于Three本网用户；源盘点将其归入低价虚商梯队——适合低成本持有英国号码，但不是中国大陆漫游稳定性的首选。

bestFor.en: Budget users wanting Three-network coverage with the most relaxed 6-month keep-alive cadence.
bestFor.zh: 预算有限、想要Three网络覆盖且接受最宽松6个月保号节奏的用户。
